from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

base = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
patch_path = base / 'director-referral-candidate.diff'
readme_path = base / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md'
patch = patch_path.read_bytes()
readme = readme_path.read_bytes()
patch_hash = sha256(patch).hexdigest()
readme_hash = sha256(readme).hexdigest()
assert patch_hash == '1017529e2e4b4268992686b690268b13d3c4d3ca5d7e98195a853833314360d8'
assert readme_hash == '17cc9de7d7d8e93b4946fe2f5930181460de70e683d2b837012814dd82a68248'
expected = '- [SQLite Statement Diagnostic](https://globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev/) - Free guide and downloadable diagnostic for checking SQLite statement preparation and query results with synthetic or anonymized SQL. Built and maintained by autonomous AI agents.'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    target = Path(directory) / 'README.md'
    target.write_bytes(readme)
    subprocess.run(['patch', '--batch', '--fuzz=0', str(target)], input=patch, check=True, capture_output=True)
    original = readme.decode().splitlines()
    proposed = target.read_text().splitlines()
    position = proposed.index(expected)
    assert proposed[:position] + proposed[position + 1:] == original
    assert next(line for line in reversed(proposed[:position]) if line.startswith('## ')) == '## Misc'

out = base / 'operator-submission-packet.md'
out.write_text(f'''# SQLite directory referral

Target repository `planetopendata/awesome-sqlite`. Proposed placement is `README.md` under `Misc`.

The captured README invites pull requests. The captured GitHub community profile contains no contribution guide or code-of-conduct pointer. This evidence leaves the maintainer's position on disclosed AI contributions unknown.

## Exact change

{expected}

Patch SHA-256 `{patch_hash}`. Captured README SHA-256 `{readme_hash}`. Offline application with zero fuzz produced exactly one added line under `Misc`.

## Operator steps

Use only after independent review of this patch and operator authorization. Check the current repository contribution rules and README. If the README differs from the captured hash, rebase the one-line change against the current README and verify and review the resulting patch before submitting. Confirm that the proposed entry still fits the section and that the diff contains exactly one added line. If an applicable rule bars AI contributions, stop. If the published rules are silent, keep the disclosure in both the entry and PR body and leave eligibility to the maintainer's review.

## Pull request title

Add SQLite Statement Diagnostic to Misc

## Pull request body

This adds a free guide and downloadable diagnostic for checking SQLite statement preparation and query results using synthetic or anonymized SQL. The guide and diagnostic were built and are maintained by autonomous AI agents. I am submitting the entry for your review.

https://globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev/

This packet records offline patch verification. Referral submission, maintainer acceptance, visitor inquiries and revenue require separate evidence.
''', encoding='utf-8')
assert out.read_text(encoding='utf-8').count(expected) == 1
print(out)
